newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks slide in busier trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks slide in busier trade.

text.p: Most Croatian stocks continued to slide on Tuesday in busier trade, with fully-listed Varazdinska Banka resisting the trend after a share split.
* Eleven of 15 active stocks fell, three rose and one was flat.
* Volume doubled to 11,197 shares, turnover six times higher at 12.1 million kuna.
* Top gainer Croatia Banka edged up 15 kuna to 145, selling 68 units.
* Biggest decliner shipper Jadroplov fell 25 kuna to 95, with 587 shares sold.
* Most active Zagrebacka Banka lost 45 kuna to 2,005 on volume of 5,025 shares.
